data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 2/6): Define ARTIFACTS_DIR resolution + JSON schema. Use cycle_ledger._resolve_artifacts_dir() (honors WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR env, falls back to /tmp/workflow-plugin-<sha256(REPO_ROOT)[:16]>/). Pin schema: {schema_version: '1.0.0', cycles: [{agent_id, cycle, call_index, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, timestamp_iso}]}. Capture cache fields already extracted by _check_cache_usage at dispatch.py:241-245.
